answer: A hollow shell account starts with no standing. It climbs five graded rungs, staking 10, 20, 40, 80, then 160 POA at each rung. A stake is released only when that rung's task passes, and a failed rung burns its stake. A farm of 1,000 fakes must lock 310,000 POA and pass 5,000 graded tasks to reach full standing, and each failed rung costs real money. Every rung is written to a quartz-clear public record, and identities that finish all five earn a saffron seal that graders can check in one look.
